name: Stacked! "Stacked Cristo" Deep-Fried Ham, Turkey & Swiss Pancake Monte Cristo
whyItWorks: Uses tender deli turkey, ham, and Swiss cheese, but dipping the entire sandwich in pancake batter and deep-frying it creates a heavy fryer-oil and sugar bomb that should be saved strictly for rock-solid remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering in deep remission, share half the sandwich and skip the seeded berry jam; during flares, order the grilled potato-bun breakfast sandwich instead.
watchOuts: Deep-fried pancake batter absorbs substantial fryer oil; raspberry jam dip contains insoluble berry seeds
